trust.title: Direct-to-Lab Delivery
trust.text: Ordered products reach your lab door directly from our partnered suppliers — no middleman delays or transit surprises.

testimonials.text: Quotations came back within hours and the consignment reached our lab on the promised day. Exactly the reliability our procurement team needed.
Having one supplier for glassware, media and PPE has cut our vendor management time in half.
Contract-backed pricing gave us predictable costs for annual budgeting across four departments.

story: Lab Restock was founded by four colleagues who saw the same problem in every lab they worked with: procurement was fragmented, deliveries were unreliable, and small orders got deprioritised. Budgets were spent chasing vendors instead of science.

We set up Lab Restock to be the single point of contact for laboratory consumables and equipment — sourcing from a network of contracted suppliers so labs, institutes, hospitals and colleges get what they need, when they need it, at consistent pricing.
about.mission: To make laboratory procurement simple, reliable and transparent for research, healthcare and education institutions.
about.vision: A world where no lab loses time to supply chain friction — where every order is one contact away, contract-backed and delivered direct.
whyDirect: Shortened lead times through direct dispatch from partner warehouses
Fewer damaged or delayed consignments from consolidated shipping
Clearer pricing via written supply contracts, not one-off quotes
A dedicated coordinator for institutional and bulk accounts
